primary.poolable_reason: SAME DRUG, SAME PLACEBO, SAME DISEASE -- AND TWO DIFFERENT KINDS OF ENDPOINT. Both trials test sotatercept against placebo in pulmonary arterial hypertension. NCT03496207 registers 'Change From Baseline in Pulmonary Vascular Resistance (PVR) at 24 Weeks' -- a continuous haemodynamic measurement. NCT04896008 registers 'Time to First Confirmed Morbidity or Mortality Event' -- a time-to-event clinical composite. A change in vascular resistance and a time to a clinical event are not two estimates of one quantity, and no conversion between them is supported by either registration.

primary.what_this_verdict_does_not_establish: NOT that any of these trials is poor -- each is registered, randomised where it says so, and reports its primary. NOT that the drug is ineffective. NOT that no poolable question exists in this area: only that the question this page's title asks cannot be answered by pooling the trials this page carries. If a further eligible trial is identified, this verdict should be revisited.
primary.poolable_DEPRECATED_note: `poolable` MEANT ONLY 'the source page pooled these trials'. It was never a judgement that the pool was sound, and the renderer read it as permission to assert 'pooled on the X scale'. RENAMED to source_page_pooled, which is what it says. `poolable` is retained so nothing breaks, and it is DEPRECATED: read source_page_pooled for what the source did, and estimand_established for whether the pool is defensible. A PAGE SHOULD DISPLAY A POOLED ESTIMATE BECAUSE ITS ESTIMAND WAS ESTABLISHED, NOT BECAUSE SOMEONE ONCE POOLED IT.
primary.estimand_established_means: TRUE only where every contributing trial has been READ and shown to measure the same quantity, or the same construct with a variance stated. FALSE where that was checked and failed. NULL where it was never checked -- AN ABSENT ASSERTION AND A NEGATIVE ONE ARE DIFFERENT STATES and null is not a pass.
